name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-07-08, at wavelengths from 1.18 to 4.99 um. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
